controls.label: Start at
controls.description: Delays the whole component (60 ticks = 1 second) so it can play after another one.

controls.label: Colour shift
controls.description: Turns all colours of this component around the colour wheel: 180 makes orange fire blue, 120 green, -60 pink. Brightness stays the same.

controls.label: Core width
controls.description: Lightning strike: corerib.width, innerrib.width ×2.692, outerrib.width ×7.115, halorib.width ×16.54
